description: Data for pluvial flood risk assessment in rural settlements of the Dosso Region, Niger is a hazard data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by Mendeley. This dataset contains information for a participatory pluvial flood risk assessment in four rural settlements of the Dosso Region, Niger. Based on the ISO 31010 standard for risk management-risk assessment, hydraulic modelling was used to ascertain flood-prone zones for each settlement in order to identify the assets in flood-prone zones. Coverage: Niger. The portal files it under the publisher Mendeley. Its tags are Hydraulics, Rural Development, Data Modelling, Participatory Evaluation, Cost Benefit Analysis. The repository dates the deposit 2021; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
